sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:40

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:40:1
items.html:
These seven kings in the four Partzufim of HB and YESHSUT etc.: We need to understand the matter of reckoning the seven kings within the four Partzufim, AVI and YESHSUT, which is the key to understanding the reign and the death of the seven kings of Nekudim, and to all the phases of ZON in ABYA, whose root is these seven kings.
We will explain them here briefly, in a general way, and further on, in the explanation of the words of the ARI, we will explain them at length and in detail. And know that five Partzufim came out here in the world of Nekudim: four Partzufim, which are Hochma, Bina, Israel Saba, and Tevuna, came out with a Rosh [head] and a Guf [body]; and the fifth Partzuf, which is the Partzuf of Daat, came out with a Rosh without a Guf. Know further that the order of the breaking of the vessels was likewise according to the order of the refinement of the screen by degree, like the order of the departure of the lights from the vessels of the Guf of the preceding Partzufim of AK. You also know that the vessels of Nekudim preceded the lights, for the vessels of the Nekudot of SAG, which expanded below the Tabur of AK, and whose lights departed at the time of the restriction of NHY of AK, and which remained empty of their lights — these passed over and became the vessels of Nekudim. For the vessels that were emptied because of the departure of the lights in the Guf of the upper one always become vessels in the lower Partzuf, as is known.
Know also that everything spoken of here concerns only the lights of Gadlut [greatness/adulthood] that came to AVI in the secret of an addition. But with the lights of Katnut [smallness/infancy], that is, with the phase of back to back of AVI, the ARI does not deal here. For in the phase of Katnut that came out from the beginning of its emanation there was no breaking or annulment at all, as above, and all the annulment and breaking and blemish was only in the lights of Gadlut that came in the phase of an addition, that is, in the coupling of face to face of AVI. And remember this.
Now, at first all the lights of Gadlut came out, all of them included in the vessel of Keter, that is, in the NHY of Keter. For Keter itself, which is the second Rosh, took no part for itself in these Mochin of Gadlut, as above. Rather, it is only because all renewals of lights necessarily come from Ein Sof, as is known, and therefore this new light must cascade from Ein Sof through all the causes that precede this Partzuf which receives and draws the new light. For this reason it is regarded as descending from Ein Sof and cascading from degree to degree until it comes to the receiver, which is the consequence of all those degrees that preceded it. Therefore it is regarded that AVI too raised MAN [female waters] to Keter, which is the phase of Galgalta and Einayim of AVI, that is, their Rosh; and Keter too to its own Rosh, and so on upward until Ein Sof. And then the new light is drawn from Ein Sof through the degrees until it comes to the phase of the drop of the coupling of Galgalta and Einayim in Keter, which are HB in Keter; and the drop clothes in the new NHY of Keter, which means complete NHY that can be revealed outward (see above, page 507, the passage beginning “They can”). And these NHY of Keter, together with the light of the drop of the coupling that is drawn from Ein Sof, descend and clothe in the Mochin of AVI.
Therefore this aforementioned light, which is called the drop of the coupling of HB in Keter, clothed in the NHY of Keter that descended to the Mochin of AVI, is regarded as the totality of all the light that expands in all five Partzufim of Nekudim. For all the degrees of Nekudim are nothing but a diminution of this general light, since it goes on diminishing from degree to degree until it vanishes and departs to its root. But since the upper light does not cease, it therefore brings out new levels in the course of its diminution, one below the other, until it vanishes and rises to the Emanator, in the manner explained regarding the departure of the lights of the preceding Partzufim. Thus that light which is clothed in the NHY of Keter is the totality of the light of all the Partzufim of Nekudim.
However, after the NHY of Keter clothed as Mochin in AVI, they had already departed entirely from the phase of Keter and were reckoned to the vessels of AVI and the light of AVI. And know that this level, which came out first, is regarded as the level of Keter of AVI, and it is called here, in the words of the ARI, by the name of the looking of the eyes of AVI at one another; for through the NHY of Keter that clothed in them as Mochin and their coupling face to face, their eyes were opened and they looked at one another, which means a coupling of Gadlut at the level of Keter of AVI. And the first expansion of the level of Keter from above downward is in the king of Daat, and from here onward the refinement of the screen of the Partzuf AVI began: for after the king of Daat broke, the screen was refined from phase four to phase three, and then the level of Hochma of AVI came out from below upward, and from above downward the ten Sefirot of the Guf expanded and clothed in the king of Hesed. And when the king of Hesed broke, the screen was refined from phase three to phase two, and the level of Bina of AVI came out from below upward, and from above downward the ten Sefirot of the Guf expanded into the king of Gevura. And when the king of Gevura broke, the screen was refined from phase two to phase one, and the phase of the Daat of AVI came out, that is, the level of ZA, which is also called the phase of the Yesodot of AVI, which came out from below upward. And its Guf expanded into the upper third of the king of Tifferet. And after the upper third of the king of Tifferet broke, the whole screen was refined and rose to its root, to the Peh [mouth] of Nekudim, and was included there in the coupling of the Rosh, and a new level of phase two came out upon it, for the last phase is always lost at the time of the refinement, as is known. And this level is called YESHSUT.
And at first the Taamim [tastes] in it came out, which are the Rosh and Guf of the first expansion, whose Rosh is called the looking of the eyes of YESHSUT at one another. And you already know that the last phase of clothing remains in the screen, except that it expands only in the vessel of Keter, which is called Taamim. And know that this is what is called the looking of the eyes, both in AVI and in YESHSUT; and in AVI it is regarded as phase four of clothing, and in YESHSUT it is regarded as phase three of clothing. And the expansion from above downward in the phase of the Taamim of AVI is called the king of Daat, and the expansion from above downward of the phase of the Taamim of YESHSUT is called the two lower thirds of Tifferet.
And after the king of Tifferet broke, the screen was refined from phase three to phase two, and the phase of YESHSUT came out from below upward, and their Guf expanded from above downward into the kings of NH. And when the kings of NH broke, the screen was refined from phase two to phase one, and the Daat of YESHSUT, which is called the Yesodot of YESHSUT, came out from below upward, and its Guf expanded and descended to the king of Yesod. And when the king of Yesod died, the screen was refined from phase one to the phase of Keter, and then the level of Malchut came out from below upward, and her Guf expanded into the Malchut of Nekudim. And when the vessel of Malchut of Nekudim broke, the screen was refined entirely and rose to its root in the Peh, and again it was included there in the coupling of the Rosh; but nothing remained in it except the coarseness of phase one, for the last phase, which is phase two, was lost in the course of the refinement. And upon it came out the level of ZA, which is the phase of Daat, whose matter will be explained before us; and this level of Daat has no expansion from above downward, as will be explained further on.
And now all the degrees that came out in Nekudim have been briefly explained: that the first degree is AVI, upon a screen of phase four and phase three together, whose first level, the Taamim in it, expanded into the king of Daat; and the Nekudot in it are the three levels that expanded, one below the other, into the three kings, Hesed, Gevura, and the upper third of Tifferet. And afterwards the second degree came out, called YESHSUT, whose Taamim, which came out upon the two records of phase three and phase two, expanded into the two lower thirds of Tifferet; and the Nekudot in it are the three levels that expanded one below the other, into the three
kings: NH, Yesod, and Malchut. And afterwards the third degree came out, called Daat, and it has nothing but the phase of from below upward, as written. And know that these three degrees, Hochma, Bina, Daat, are the secret of Neshama, Ruach, Nefesh.
